description: Move one agreement exactly one step: draft, sent, signed, expired, stamping the date and an optional note into its history. A skipped or backwards step is refused and nothing is written. Expiring a finished engagement frees a free-tier slot.

agreement.description: The agreement id, e.g. SA-2026-0003, or the client name when only one agreement has it

date.description: The date to stamp the step with, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

status.description: The next step for this agreement: draft, sent, signed, expired

name: agreement_update_status
title: Move an agreement one step
